name: CHARM
summary: CHARM operated in CERN SPS's historical West Area as a neutrino / beam experiment. This record focuses on dark-sector reinterpretations and does not describe all its original physics as dark-matter searches.
detection_principle: In historical high-energy proton-beam-dump data, weakly coupled particles may traverse shielding and decay to lepton pairs. Modern reinterpretations use the original geometry, exposure and selections to test new dark-sector models.

results.summary: Joint studies with historical data including NuCal improve constraint coverage for some dark-photon and inelastic-dark-matter models.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered. This record includes reinterpretations of historical data in new models. A reinterpretation paper's publication year is not the apparatus operating year, and the original experiment may primarily have targeted neutrinos, axions or other light particles.
